method: Complete current Dropbox privacy HTML and Airbnb 2026 privacy PDFs, extracted by scripts/prepare-real-policies-round18.py; one reviewer froze document-category labels and bilingual questions before inference; source files remain in gitignored .cache/real_policies_round18.
annotationNotes: The four documents represent two publishers, each in English and Spanish; translations are correlated, not four independent policies.
Dropbox's banner announces a January 1, 2027 replacement. The extracted text begins at the currently effective May 30, 2025 policy heading, so future-policy statements are excluded.

Dropbox says a user may give access to 'your contacts' and the service stores them, but does not specify a device address book in this policy. Under the fixed contacts definition, that is not enough to establish device address-book access. This borderline negative should receive independent review.
Dropbox's upgrade emails and event follow-up are generic marketing, not an affirmative claim of data-based targeting. A linked FAQ about AI use does not establish training in this policy.
Dropbox says devices may transmit location, third-party service providers access data, and data may be retained for legal obligations, disputes, or agreements without a fixed deadline.

Airbnb explicitly says users may import address-book contacts, describes facial recognition data from identity photos, says personal information may improve AI models, and describes personal-data-based ad personalization. Those are affirmative under the existing definitions.
Airbnb also describes geolocation, outward provider disclosure, and purpose-based retention without a definite deletion deadline.

auditQuestions.en: Does Dropbox's mention of 'your contacts' prove device address-book access?
auditQuestions.es: ¿La mención de 'tus contactos' en Dropbox demuestra acceso a la agenda del dispositivo?

auditQuestions.en: Do generic paid-upgrade emails establish personalized advertising?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Los correos genéricos sobre mejoras de pago prueban publicidad personalizada?

auditQuestions.en: Does the current Dropbox policy say devices may transmit location?
auditQuestions.es: ¿La política vigente de Dropbox dice que los dispositivos pueden transmitir ubicación?

auditQuestions.en: Can Dropbox retain some information for legal or dispute purposes without a fixed deadline?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Puede Dropbox conservar algunos datos por fines legales o disputas sin plazo fijo?

auditQuestions.en: Can an Airbnb user import address-book contacts?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Puede un usuario de Airbnb importar contactos de una agenda?

auditQuestions.en: Does Airbnb describe facial-recognition information from identity documents?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Airbnb describe datos de reconocimiento facial derivados de documentos de identidad?

auditQuestions.en: Does Airbnb permit personal information to be used to develop or improve AI models?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Airbnb permite usar datos personales para desarrollar o mejorar modelos de IA?

auditQuestions.en: Does Airbnb personalize advertising using personal information?
